tagline: An established regional refrigerated carrier with cross-border authority
overview: Project Coastline is a regional trucking company in British Columbia that moves refrigerated and dry freight for food distributors and retailers. It runs its own modern terminal, keeps a steady base of repeat shippers and holds the authorities and certifications needed for cross-border work. A capable general manager runs day-to-day operations.

highlights.title: Repeat shippers
highlights.detail: Most revenue comes from customers who have shipped with the Company for years.

highlights.title: Cross-border authority
highlights.detail: Certified for trusted cross-border trade, which few smaller carriers hold.

highlights.title: Modern terminal
highlights.detail: A purpose-built terminal on a long lease gives room to grow without new capital.

highlights.title: Management in place
highlights.detail: A general manager and dispatch team run the business day to day.

highlights.title: Balanced freight mix
highlights.detail: Refrigerated, dry van and drayage work spread the risk across seasons.

growth.title: A second terminal
growth.detail: A terminal in a neighbouring province would serve existing customers' new lanes.

growth.title: Port drayage
growth.detail: Demand for container moves to and from the port is growing.

growth.title: Dedicated contracts
growth.detail: Several shippers have asked for dedicated equipment.

whoItSuits: A larger carrier adding refrigerated capacity in western Canada
A private equity platform building a logistics group
An operator ready to step in with a strong manager in place
transition: The owner offers a 6-month handover; the general manager plans to stay
managementNote: A general manager with long tenure runs operations, supported by a dispatch lead and an experienced office team. The owner has stepped back from daily decisions.

listingPhrases.supportTraining: The owner stays for the handover
